summary: Iteration 50 - Frontend-only validation of the new 'Comprobante revisado' visual guardrail on the admin NotificationBell modal. Tested 7 scenarios across two Playwright runs against the production preview URL with admin (admi@paylionsbit.es): (1) login OK; (2) POS notif TEST-216389 initial state: notif-view-proof-btn has data-proof-viewed='false' and label 'Ver Comprobante'; notif-add-balance-btn has data-proof-viewed='false' and label 'Agregar Saldo al Usuario' - PASS; (3) After clicking Ver Comprobante and 1x1 PNG renders inside notif-proof-image: notif-add-balance-btn switches to data-proof-viewed='true' with label 'Comprobante revisado . Agregar Saldo' and emerald-glow ring class - PASS; (4) After closing the inline viewer with notif-proof-close: notif-view-proof-btn re-appears with data-proof-viewed='true' and label 'Comprobante revisado . Ver de nuevo' (CheckCheck icon, cyan-700 bg) while notif-add-balance-btn keeps its reviewed state - PASS; (5) CONTROL 'Nuevo Retiro' (TEST-CONTROL): zero notif-view-proof-btn rendered; notif-add-balance-btn present with data-proof-viewed='false' - PASS; (6) State reset on opening a different notif (POS re-opened after reviewing): both buttons reset to data-proof-viewed='false' with default labels - PASS; (7) NEG path (NONEXISTENT-REF-999): backend returns 404, frontend surfaces notif-proof-empty with 'No hay comprobante disponible para esta transferencia.', notif-add-balance-btn remains data-proof-viewed='false' with label 'Agregar Saldo al Usuario' (NO switch to reviewed) - PASS. Regression of the inline 'Agregar Saldo' form (amount, currency, submit) also rendered correctly after toggling. Total: 7/7 scenarios PASS. No backend testing performed (frontend-only request).
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.jsx now ~570 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold. With each iteration adding more inline UI (proof viewer, add-balance form, proofViewed state), consider extracting BankTransferProofViewer and AdminAddBalanceForm into dedicated components to keep the bell component focused on list+detail orchestration.

proofViewed state is bound to the selectedNotif lifecycle but is NOT persisted server-side - if the admin closes the modal and the page reloads, the 'revisado' badge disappears. For a true audit-grade guardrail consider POSTing a 'proof_reviewed_at' marker on the notification or payment record and reading it on render. Without this, the visual hint is only a UX nudge, not a real workflow gate.

The reviewed style on notif-add-balance-btn (ring + emerald glow) might be perceived by some admins as the action being already completed - the label still says 'Agregar Saldo' so semantics are OK, but a small subtitle like 'Listo para acreditar' could reduce ambiguity. Minor UX.

Click-outside handler on the dropdown uses 'mousedown' which can fire BEFORE React's click on the notification item if the user mouse-downs slightly outside while moving. Low-priority edge case, but switching to 'click' would be safer.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The admin has 50+ notifications - new test notifs land at the TOP of the dropdown (list ordered by created_at desc). Two notification-bell elements exist on the page (mobile header + sidebar); always filter by .is_visible() before clicking. ESC closes the Dialog cleanly. Reusable selectors: notif-view-proof-btn (with data-proof-viewed attr), notif-add-balance-btn (with data-proof-viewed attr), notif-proof-viewer, notif-proof-image, notif-proof-empty, notif-proof-close. State key insight: proofViewed is reset to false inside handleNotificationClick() on every notification open - this is verified working. Negative path (404) gated by the `if (!data.has_file)` branch in handleViewProof - if backend returns 200 with has_file=false (e.g. proof record exists but is empty), the button would also stay unreviewed - same code path as 404, not retested.
